page_counting_rule: Count only chapter body pages (chapter opener through last body page). Exclude front matter, Key Terms, Key Concepts and Summary, Self-Check/Review/Critical Thinking questions and Problems. Page numbers are 1-based physical PDF pages, not printed book page numbers (printed = PDF - 10).
